notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Fixed fireplace sound
Fixed an issue where some skill tree icons did not match their effects

notes.title: Ranking Name System Update
notes.content: [p]Player names for the ranking system were previously freely editable, but have now been changed to use word combinations.[/p]

notes.title: Update 20250529
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where ranking data would not update when the highest record and distance were the same and the time was also identical.
(Note: Rankings are now updated only when you exceed your local best record, rather than at the time of the update itself.)

Experimental controller support added.
(A virtual mouse will appear when using a controller and pressing a button.)
